verdict.rationale: Codegen offers a Python SDK/API to create and run agents, pull their work, retrieve traces, and trigger from CI/CD, plus a CLI mirroring several UI actions, giving real API-level control over agent execution. However, no OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (404s) and there's no evidence that integration setup (Slack, Jira, Linear, GitHub App connections) or org/repo configuration done in the UI is fully exposed via the API. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI reference, confirmed API parity for integration/config management, and independent verification that all UI workflows are API-reachable.
